newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Belgrade police question Bosnian Serb leader.
newsitem.headline: Belgrade police question Bosnian Serb leader.

text.p: Police briefly detained Bosnian Serb President Biljana Plavsic at Belgrade airport on Sunday when she returned from a visit to Britain, Studio B television reported.
She was allowed to travel back to the Bosnian Serb republic after questioning. There was no immediate explanation for her detention.

Plavsic has been isolated since her election last year by Bosnian Serb hardliners led by ex-President Radovan Karadzic and Momcilo Krajisnik who is the Bosnian Serb member of Bosnia's collective presidency.
Interior Minister Dragan Kijac, a Karadzic loyalist, is resisting attempts by Plavsic to replace him as part of her efforts to crack down on corruption rackets involving leading hardliners.
Plavsic is also unpopular with Serbian President Slobodan Milosevic and his allies and earlier this year refused to sign a cooperation agreement between Yugoslavia and the Bosnian Serb republic.
